The spectral dancer can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain.

It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

The spectral dancer can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain.

Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and the target is affected by Possessive Partner.

The spectral dancer reaches out and touches a living creature in attempt to begin dancing with them.
While in sunlight, the spectral dancer has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

As a reaction to a weapon attack the the Spectral Dancer shifts itself to the Ethereal Plane briefly, causing the attack to instead miss.

The Spectral Dancers pirouttes away from their foe, briefly becoming intangible.

The Spectral Dancer selects a living creature that has not acted yet and reduces their initiative by 2 for the rest of the combat. If there are no valid targets for the spectral dancer, their initiative instead increases by 2. This ability can be used once per day.

The Spectral Dancer causes the timing of all living creatures around it to shift.

The spectral dancers create a psychic link to a living creature that they successfully hit with their Ghostly Touch attack. If the linked creature ends their turn while not adjacent to the spectral dancers they are linked to the bond snaps.

When this happens they must make a DC 14 Charisma save, taking 6 (2d6) psychic damage on failure and half damage on success.

This link harmlessly breaks if the spectral dancer is defeated.

The Spectral Dancer selects a living creature as its ill-fated dance partner!
